adaptation: Report feature generation/write, cache reads, all LR/seed fits including VAL and checkpoint I/O, LR selection, integrity/cost probes; count each component once

training.input: CPU standardized canonical TRAIN contexts, or exact immutable frozen-prefix cache on CPU
training.old_selected_models: MSE_LORA and LEVEL, each two seeds per dataset; online only
training.scope: Fresh disposable selected-model state per block; AdamW initialized, moments created during warmup; complete transfer/forward/loss/backward/clip/step and synchronized timing
training.checkpoint_preservation: Hash selected checkpoint before and after all probes, never overwrite a selected file
training.memory: Peak CUDA allocated/reserved after Adam initialization plus process RAM; state whether frozen prefix remains GPU-resident

deployment.scope: CPU FP32 input to full backbone plus readout to contiguous CPU [B,48,C] output; synchronize GPU; no feature-cache deployment shortcut
deployment.aggregation: Per-instance block medians/range, then mean selected-seed median; sentinel drift and failures retained

historical_costs: Context only; no speed ratio combines another campaign's costs
interpretation: Cache-enabled adaptation speed and online training cost are distinct; cache prefix offloading is not deployment model compression
